properties.description: ChangeEvent.rationale_basis (contemporaneous / recalled / unknown) and ChangeEvent.commits, writable from add_change_event along with repair / stands_in_for. The confirmation ledger counts recalled and unknown changes as `recalled_changes`, apart from `design_edits`, so they never move a capability from unexamined to confirmed; repair_report counts unstated recalled repairs as `unstated_recalled`. Old fixes are kept out of the forward-only cause rule by the existing parking mechanism under one owner-approved ruling per project.
properties.name: A recorded change says how its reason is known, and a recalled one is never read as a check
